actions.name: trampling charge
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.nZthq6WHLhcdu3te.Item.7DSbBzpS1e9lYxZx]{gore} attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be knocked &reference[prone]. If the target is prone, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can make one attack with its [[/item .O8oahxePfpHFYohz]]{hooves} against it as a bonus action.

actions.name: petrifying breath
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales petrifying gas in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=I95hdnCSX03wF7Er]]. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw. On a failed save, a target begins to turn to stone and is &reference[restrained]. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on the target. On a failure, the target is &reference[petrified] until freed by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.WzvJ7G3cqvIubsLk]{greater restoration} spell or other magic.
